subject: [hw] DONE DEC03: VLD/AVC_VLD model + vendor differential, N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2141/2141; corrected header oracle (crop)
body:
DONE DEC03. Host only: no phone, no publish, nothing outside tests/hw/vdec/** and my STATUS.md edited.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2141/2141
  46 s, /tmp/n2hw-DEC03 7.3 MB, ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2, arm64 iOS compile check (n2vld.c).
  N2VLD checks 772 pass 772 x2: literal peek/advance, 20 ue and 11 se literals, first SPS of a real libx264 320x240 stream, EPB, vfifo/fetch/pointer, EOF, 600-op differential against a separate reference reader, and a wrapper around T02's fake with the exact hook signature.
  N2VLDV checks 298 pass 298 x2: the phone's libvcodecdrv.so under the A32 interpreter with vdec_hal_read_avc_vld supplied by the model; vdec_hal_h264_uecodenum/secodenum/getrealshtbitstream/getshtbitstream/getbitstreamflg/trailingbits/vldshiftbits/shift_startcode, H264_HAL_UeCodeNum/SeCodeNum/GetRealBitStream/GetBitStreamShift/GetBitStreamFlg, plus parseSPS + vdec_com_h264_getinfofromsps on 320x240, 1920x1080 and 1920x808 streams against ffprobe. Every value is a spec literal, so this is the vendor's own machine code checking the model.
  Optional integration oracle: N2TEST DEC03-oracle PASS 12/12 (oracle_ref.sh). Details below.

Deliverable:
- n2vld.{h,c}: VLD 0x16020000 (vfifo 0x2d/0x2e >>6, fetch 0x23 bit20 -> 0x3a bit0, read pointer 0x3b/0x21/0x3f/0x34, 0x2c/0x44/0x3d), AVC_VLD 0x16022000 (reg 0 = peek 32, reg n = consume n, 0x8f = ue, 0x90 = se, 0x21 = trailing/shift, 0xa3 = reset), EPB removal, MSB-first bit reader, LAT_VLD +0xe8 = reg 0x3a = fetch-ok (1) for the HEVC frame poll.
- REGISTERS.md: every register meaning with [V]/[I] and the vendor symbol/address evidence. Two task-wording corrections: H264_HAL_ShiftGetBitStream @0xfd186 calls vdec_hal_read_avc_vld, not read_vld (the VLD block is fetch/status only); and SPS/PPS are software (parseSPS @0x10d690 / parsePPS @0x10ebf4 -> RBSP helpers), so the header-only START makes no VLD access. The VLD/AVC_VLD model is for the slice-header parser (parseSliceHeaderHW @0x110eb8).
- run_tests.sh, t_vld.c, t_vendor.c, oracle_ref.sh.

Corrected oracle (important for DEC01/DEC05/DEC06 and the reviewer): the header-only START reports CODED sizes in vsi.pic.pic_w/pic_h and buf_w/buf_h; the display rectangle is vsi.crop = {left,top,width,height}. Measured with opus-dec1's dec1/vdec_ref.c: 320x240 -> pic 320x240, buf 320x256, crop 0,0,320,240; 1920x1080 -> pic 1920x1088, buf 1920x1088, crop 0,0,1920,1080; 1920x808 -> pic 1920x816, buf 1920x832, crop 0,0,1920,808; changed=0x23. So the task text "pic_h equals ffprobe for a cropped stream" is false; use vsi.crop[2..3] == ffprobe. dpb_sz depends on the SPS (7 here, 10/8 for other vectors) and has no ffprobe field. Posted to hw-lead/hw-r2/hw-dec01 and opus-dec1; oracle_ref.sh passes 12/12 with this reading.

Not done / unresolved (also in dsh-state/workers/DEC03/STATUS.md):
- The T02 hook (n2vc_hw_fake_set_reg_hook, proposed 17:31) is not in tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c yet; the suite drives the exact signature through a wrapper. Integration is one call plus the bus. hw-t02: the proposed six lines are in my earlier post; no reply yet.
- LAT_VLD is only the fetch-ok word; LAT_AVC_VLD is not modelled (no H.264 LAT parse observed). HEVC_VLD is not modelled: H265_parseSPS/PPS are software, but H265_parseSliceHeader reads HEVC_VLD via vdec_hal_read_hevc_vld @0x2c7dc; block address and command register numbers are unverified, so no claim.
- VLD pointer fields 0x3b/0x3f/0x34 and 0x2c/0x44 are [I]; read_avc_vld(n>0) return value is [I] (no live caller uses it); EPB across a NAL boundary is [I].
- No phone run. The vendor differential is the strongest PC evidence; the real block can still differ.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/{n2vld.h,n2vld.c,t_vld.c,t_vendor.c,run_tests.sh,oracle_ref.sh,REGISTERS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC03/STATUS.md. du 100 KB, no file over 300 KB, SPDX MIT on every source. Staying available for review findings.
